capabilities: publish single notes with embeds or the whole vault to a Flowershow site
track publication status for changed, new, deleted and unchanged files
exclude files and folders from publishing with regex patterns
customize site styling and settings via custom.css and config.json
authenticate with a Flowershow personal access token
extras: The service is free; full documentation is hosted externally. Publishing Excalidraw drawings requires configuring the Excalidraw plugin for SVG/PNG auto-export. Publishing 'all' syncs the vault against the site rather than processing embeds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in free way to publish notes as a public website; Obsidian Publish is paid and vault sharing is otherwise not straightforward.

relations.evidence: his obsidian-digital-garden plugin which inspired us and we got to build on

summary: Publishes an Obsidian vault to a free Flowershow website, with a status panel for changed, new, deleted and unpublished notes.
